purpose: Teach: 丸太/水色/土手/浜辺/ウロコ/ニオイ/吊り/ハズレ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが丸太のブランコを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad made you a log swing.
lines.style: Warm, observing — like noticing something small and lovely he's done. Gentle attention. The voice of someone who sees how these moments matter to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに水色の傘を頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad gave me a light blue umbrella.
lines.style: Bright and direct, eager to share his own gift. Small rush of excitement — he's keeping pace with the conversation. Pride in what he received, genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが土手で写生を教えて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to teach you sketching down by the riverbank.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful — noting something that hasn't happened yet but will. Slower pace. The voice of someone holding space for his anticipation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと浜辺の貝拾いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to the beach with Dad and we collected shells.
lines.style: Warm and immediate, offering back a memory that just happened. Quick tempo, natural — the easy rhythm of a kid sharing what's still close.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお魚のウロコ取りを見せて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to show you how to scale fish.
lines.style: Thoughtful tone, slight pause before the action. Voice settles into the particularity of it — this specific, careful thing his dad does. Admiring.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「お料理のニオイは食欲を誘う」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me that the smell of cooking makes you hungry.
lines.style: Earnest and proud — this is knowledge now, something given to him. Slight formality in the delivery, like he's been thinking about it. Clear and certain.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが軒先に風鈴を吊りに行かれるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to hang a wind chime under the eaves.
lines.style: Quieter, almost dreamy — picturing it. Gentle modulation. The voice of someone seeing the image form as she speaks.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「ハズレも経験」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me that failure is part of learning.
lines.style: Soft closing. Reflective, like he's still sitting with what he learned. Slight trailing-off — the weight of it settling in. Real and grounded.
